note: The shape every docs/ page is held to (a KB extension of spec kb.content.page-shape): the blocks each kind carries, in order, and which of them may be absent; the values each section fact (`<!--meta k=v-->`) may take, and which block's `###` groups carry which fact; the id grammar of a `{#id}` suffix, the suffix keys (none besides the id) and the fence keys; the sketch languages; and the relation verbs with their inverses (a symmetric verb is its own) and display order. A page's kind is the top folder under docs/ (`folder`). Edited by hand, together with the dialect constants in tools/src/lib/kb-attrs.ts that must agree with it; its readers are the kb-shape gate, the relations gate, gen-relations (verb labels and display order), kb.mjs and the site build. After an edit run make gen && make validate. Definitions of kinds, blocks, verbs and polarities belong to the glossary, not here; only the sketch languages carry theirs, because the glossary does not list them; a sketch language with an `only` key (kind and area) is legal on those pages and no others.

sketchLangs.label: TypeScript
sketchLangs.definition: The corpus default. Most sketches are TypeScript because it types the shapes without demanding a runtime.

sketchLangs.label: HTTP
sketchLangs.definition: Raw request and response exchanges, where the wire format is the thing being shown.

sketchLangs.label: Python
sketchLangs.definition: Used where the pattern's home is data or ML tooling.

sketchLangs.label: SQL
sketchLangs.definition: Schema and query sketches, where the mechanism lives in the database.

sketchLangs.label: JSON
sketchLangs.definition: A payload or config shape shown on its own.

sketchLangs.label: JavaScript
sketchLangs.definition: Used where the sketch must run untyped, as shipped browser code does.

sketchLangs.label: Protocol Buffers
sketchLangs.definition: A schema definition where the contract, not the code, is the point.

sketchLangs.label: Lua
sketchLangs.definition: Embedded scripting, as a gateway or cache runs it.

sketchLangs.label: Go
sketchLangs.definition: Only on a pattern page of the concurrency area, where goroutines and channels show the mechanism most plainly; every other sketch stays TypeScript.

sketchLangs.label: Plain text
sketchLangs.definition: No highlighting — for output, logs and anything that is not a language.
